title: US travel advice for Taiwan: Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions
summary:
Exercise normal precaution in Taiwan .
There is a risk of natural disasters in Taiwan, including earthquakes, tsunamis, typhoons, flooding, and extreme heat.

title: CVE-2025-61757: Oracle Fusion Middleware Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability

title: CVE-2025-13223: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows for heap corruption.

title: CVE-2025-58034: Fortinet FortiWeb OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Fortinet FortiWeb contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code on the underlying system via crafted HTTP requests or CLI commands.

title: CVE-2025-64446: Fortinet FortiWeb Path Traversal Vulnerability
summary: Fortinet FortiWeb contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute administrative commands on the system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

title: CVE-2025-12480: Gladinet Triofox Improper Access Control Vulnerability
summary: Gladinet Triofox contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows access to initial setup pages even after setup is complete.

title: CVE-2025-62215: Microsoft Windows Race Condition Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability that allows a local attacker with low-level privileges to escalate privileges. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could enable the attacker to gain SYSTEM-level access.

title: CVE-2025-9242: WatchGuard Firebox Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
summary: WatchGuard Firebox contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process that may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

title: CVE-2025-21042: Samsung Mobile Devices Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
summary: Samsung mobile devices contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in libimagecodec.quram.so. This vulnerability could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code.

title: CVE-2025-48703: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command Injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via shell metacharacters in the t_total parameter in a filemanager changePerm request. A valid non-root username must be known.

title: CVE-2025-11371: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
summary: Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.
